name: Heart-hand syndrome, Slovenian type

criteria.description: Presence of congenital cardiac malformations, especially atrial or ventricular septal defects
Characteristic upper limb malformations including brachydactyly and syndactyly
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital cardiac malformations and upper limb malformations with or without supportive family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may aid diagnosis but no specific gene identified

pathognomonic.symptomName: Abnormal electrophysiology of sinoatrial node origin

imaging: Echocardiography showing atrial and/or ventricular septal defects
X-rays of hands revealing brachydactyly and syndactyly
genetic: No specific gene identified; suspected autosomal dominant inheritance pattern
other: Family history consistent with heart-hand syndrome phenotype

distinguishingFeatures: Congenital heart defects with different skeletal features

redFlags: Severe congenital heart defects requiring early surgical intervention
Family history of sudden cardiac death
references: Orphanet: Heart-hand syndrome, Slovenian type - ORPHA:168796
Brusco A et al. Heart-hand syndromes: clinical and molecular insights. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Smith L et al. Congenital heart defects and limb anomalies: a review of heart-hand syndromes. Pediatr Cardiol. 2021.
